business_case_summary:
Business Case Summary: PDF Text Extractor (DEM-2026-0004)

Executive Summary
This project delivers a PDF text extractor tool to streamline text extraction from PDF files in the Infrastructure domain.

Direct Business Value/Impact
It reduces manual data entry time, enhances document processing efficiency, and enables better data integration across systems.

Potential Risk Mitigation
Low-risk project with standard input validation to prevent vulnerabilities; thorough testing ensures reliable extraction without data loss.
